figures.finding: A minor of seven or more (to eighteen) has limited capacity: their declarations need the legal representative's permission, and a contract made without it takes effect only when the representative ratifies it; a representative may allow the minor to run a business independently, and the minor then has capacity for it; an employer of anyone under eighteen must keep the legal representative's written consent; no share of earnings is set aside.

value.binding: legal representative's permission beforehand (Civil Code art. 77) or ratification after (art. 79)
value.independentBusiness: with the representative's permission the minor has capacity for that business (art. 85)
value.employment: employer keeps the legal representative's written consent and proof of age (LSA art. 46)

figures.applies: The Civil Code rule reaches every contract, so writing, directing and producing deals as well as performing; LSA art. 46 reaches every employee under eighteen. No set-aside of earnings was found in either (blocker).

sources.said: 未滿七歲之未成年人，無行為能力。 滿七歲以上之未成年人，有限制行為能力。
限制行為能力人為意思表示及受意思表示，應得法定代理人之允許。但純獲法律上利益，或依其年齡及身分、日常生活所必需者，不在此限。
限制行為能力人未得法定代理人之允許，所訂立之契約，須經法定代理人之承認，始生效力。
法定代理人允許限制行為能力人獨立營業者，限制行為能力人，關於其營業，有行為能力。
未滿十八歲之人受僱從事工作者，雇主應置備其法定代理人同意書及其年齡證明文件。

figures.finding: No one under fifteen may be employed unless the competent authority finds the work and its setting harmless to body and mind and permits it, and the same applies to a child under fifteen paid for services without an employment relationship (a child performer's case); such children and child workers of fifteen to sixteen work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, not on rest days, and never between 8pm and 6am.

value.permit: permission of the competent authority (主管機關許可), LSA art. 45
value.restDays: no work on regular days off

figures.applies: Art. 45 reaches anyone under fifteen who provides services for pay, employed or not, so a young writer or director paid on a production is reached as a performer is. The central authority's regulation on the criteria and review procedure (art. 45(3)) wasn't found in the database's search (blocker).

sources.said: 雇主不得僱用未滿十五歲之人從事工作。但國民中學畢業或經主管機關認定其工作性質及環境無礙其身心健康而許可者，不在此限。 前項受僱之人，準用童工保護之規定。
未滿十五歲之人透過他人取得工作為第三人提供勞務，或直接為他人提供勞務取得報酬未具勞僱關係者，準用前項及童工保護之規定。
十五歲以上未滿十六歲之受僱從事工作者，為童工。 … 童工每日之工作時間不得超過八小時，每週之工作時間不得超過四十小時，例假日不得工作。 第 48 條 童工不得於午後八時至翌晨六時之時間內工作。

figures.finding: The Film Act's rewards go to film enterprises and film personnel (for prizes, markets, technology, screenings and script development), with no age rule.

FilmAct.who: film enterprises (電影事業) and film personnel (電影從業人員)

figures.applies: The Ministry of Culture's subsidy rules for domestic features (輔導金) weren't found in the database (blocker); a minor applying contracts under Civil Code arts. 77-79.

figures.finding: A promoter of a company limited by shares must have full capacity, so no minor may be one; directors of both a company limited by shares and a limited company are chosen from persons with capacity, so a director must be eighteen.
figures.applies: From the Company Act arts. 108, 128 and 192 read with the Civil Code art. 13 (a minor has at most limited capacity).
